answer: One robust defense is requiring each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can earn reputation or rewards. Creating many fake identities then stops being free: every clone must fund its own stake, and misbehavior slashes it. Like water carving a karst landscape, cheap identities erode quickly under this cost, while a single honest agent standing on a knoll of accumulated, verifiable work keeps its stake intact and its history portable. A sybil operator faces linear cost per identity but only linear reward, so mass fakery becomes unprofitable.
